title: Bound bulk-shipment settlement scalars before financial commitment
description: Close bulk-settlement TotalAmount and FreightCost persisted range/precision checks by reusing the established scalar guard. FinanceBulkSettlementLifecycleRules.NormalizeTotalAmount/NormalizeCost only storage-round2 and check signs, so huge positive input reaches actual SQL default decimal(18,2). Bound rounded values before number/header mutation, revalidate stored exact consistency at submit/approval inside existing settlement locks and keep current authority/customer scope. Bulk documents have no currency field and no total==freight equation; preserve both facts. Confine shared FinanceSettlementControllers edits to bulk paths; container regression remains mandatory. Preserve all existing identities/menu/customer scope, live masters, source ownership, deterministic row locks and transaction contracts. No new permissions, schema/migration, currency conversion or implicit inventory/finance posting. Historical reads and undo actions retain existing rules; no new draft-validity gate on cancel/void/unaudit. Adapt required original fixtures with genuine live identities/masters and original assertions intact. Explicit logs/TRX/results under .ai/logs/<task> only, preserve full original failures. Verify actual EF/SQL column types in a fresh GUID-owned isolated NEWERP_AUTOTEST; never production access, drop/reset or existing database reuse. Retain existing live identity/menu/customer-scope authority, transactions, source locks, controlled errors and audit. Reject before numbering or persistence, with zero header/detail/source/status mutations. No new permissions, schema, production access, external service or arbitrary SQL. Genuine SQL only on (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets and never drop/reset. Require safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine SQL/browser tests; accurately record blockers and do not claim whole-stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Authorized manual/linked create and update bounds each scalar after existing two-decimal normalization against actual EF/SQL storage before numbering or tracked mutation. Preserve positive total and nonnegative cost, optional zero costs and existing rounding; no invented total/cost equation, currencies or aggregate/report caps.

Submit/approve revalidates stored scalar consistency within existing document/source locks, rejecting unpersistable or precision-inconsistent values without silently changing historical snapshots. Preserve explicit source eligibility/capacity and approval/cancellation restrictions, zero number/header/source/status changes on rejection and unchanged undo rules.

Meaningful pure/controller and genuine isolated SQL cases cover real column precision, exact legal boundary/just-over/round-up/huge decimal, valid zero-cost and manual/linked lifecycle, malformed stored values, denied zero writes/numbering and readable/cancellable history. Execute related original authorization/source/concurrency/cancellation SQL regressions and safe Release/full units; accurately record environment blockers.
